Bill.BriefDescription: Expanding the activities that may be funded by the prostitution prevention and intervention account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prostitution prevention and interventionservices funded by the prostitution prevention and interventionaccount; and amending RCW 43.63A.720, 43.63A.730, and 43.63A.740.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.63A.720 and 1995 c 353 s 7 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) There is established in the department of community, trade, andeconomic development a grant program to enhance funding forprostitution prevention and intervention services, law enforcementtraining, and community outreach and education. Activities that can befunded through this grant program ((shall provide effectiveprostitution prevention and intervention services, such as counseling,parenting, housing relief, education, and vocational training, that: (1) Comprehensively address the problems of persons who areprostitutes; and (2) Enhance the ability of persons to leave or avoid prostitution))include but are not limited to: (a) Services directed to address the impact of sexual assault,residential treatment and services, mental health and chemical p. 1 SSB 6683dependency services, parenting services, housing assistance, educationand vocational training, or intensive case management services. Theseactivities must (i) address the problems of persons who are eitherprostitutes or minors who have a history of engaging in sexual conductfor a fee or who are victims of commercial sexual abuse of a minor orboth; and (ii) enhance the ability of persons to leave or avoidprostitution or to cease or avoid being a victim of commercial sexualabuse of a minor; or (b) Law enforcement training, community outreach, and educationregarding prostitution and minors who have a history of engaging insexual conduct for a fee or are the victims of commercial sexual abuseof a minor, including law enforcement training regarding theavailability of services for minors under chapter 13.32A RCW. (2) For the purposes of this section, "commercial sexual abuse ofa minor" has the same meaning as provided in RCW 9.68A.100.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.63A.730 and 1995 c 353 s 9 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) At a minimum, grant applications to provide services under RCW43.63A.720(1)(a) must include the following: (((1))) (a) The proposed geographic service area; (((2))) (b) A description of the extent and effect of the needs forprostitution prevention and intervention within the relevant geographicarea; (((3))) (c) An explanation of how the funds will be used, theirrelationship to existing services available within the community, andthe need that they will fulfill; (((4))) (d) An explanation of what organizations were involved inthe development of the proposal; and (((5))) (e) The methods that will be employed to measure thesuccess of the program. (2) At a minimum, grant applications to provide services under RCW43.63A.720(1)(b) must include the following: (a) The proposed geographic outreach and education area or proposedselected law enforcement population, as applicable; (b) An explanation of how the funds will be used, theirrelationship to existing training, outreach or education servicesavailable within the community, and the need that they will fulfill; SSB 6683 p. 2 (c) An explanation of what organizations were involved in thedevelopment of the proposal; and (d) The methods that will be employed to measure the success of theprogram.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.63A.740 and 1995 c 353 s 11 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The prostitution prevention and intervention account is created inthe state treasury. All designated receipts from fees under RCW9.68A.105 and 9A.88.120 shall be deposited into the account.Expenditures from the account may be used only for funding the grantprogram ((to enhance prostitution prevention and interventionservices)) as provided under RCW 43.63A.720.
